title: 第25章 五方旗帜藏洪荒水火葫芦战混沌第26章 通天悟透兄弟情阐教金仙嘴脸显
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
林镜看着手中熠熠生辉的中央戊己杏黄旗，心中已经开始盘算起来其余的宝物的情况了！
这先天五方旗来头不小，其余几扇都在其他几位洪荒大能的身上，想要获取难度不小啊！
首先这南方离地焰光旗就在人教太清圣人手中，而且先天葫芦之中的紫金红色葫芦也在那里！
太清圣人讲究清净无为，和截教的关系还算融洽，这两件灵宝应该有希望借到手一用！
看来此间事了，他要找个机会去人教拜访一番了！
东方青莲宝色旗应该是在西方教准提道人的手上，这一件林镜肯定是最后考虑的！
西方教这两位圣人可不好惹，万一被他们发现真身，灭除真灵再次炼化成灵宝可就惨了！
不过这西方二圣身上好东西可真不少，七宝妙树，六根清净竹，十二品功德金莲……
而西方云界素色旗据说是鸿钧传给了座下弟子瑶池，也就是后来的天庭王母！
这紫霄宫林镜现在也不敢去，亲自面对鸿钧圣人还是有压力的！
可是这紫绿色葫芦也在鸿钧弟子昊天的手上，怎么感觉这任务就是想让他去送死的呢？
除了圣人还是圣人，就剩下一个目标了……
北方玄元控水旗的掌控者，冥河老祖！
这冥河老祖也算是个苦命人了，虽然也听过鸿钧讲道，也是紫霄宫三千大能之一！
可惜却卡在了准圣大圆满之上，一直无法成功证道成圣！
当年女娲圣人感悟造化之道，创立人族成圣！
他也借鉴了一下，在幽冥血海创造出来阿修罗族，可惜未能成圣！
后来三清感悟教化之道，分别立教得大功德成圣！
他也借鉴了一下，在幽冥血海立阿修罗教，可惜还是未能成圣！
后来准提接引立西方教，并且发下四十八大宏远借来巨量功德成圣！

这次他没有借鉴了，因为准提接引已经把天道薅秃了，他想借也没有了……
不过这冥河老祖在血海之中，其实力也是只在圣人之下而已！
终于找到唯一一个不是圣人的，可是林镜也惹不起……
这收集任务似乎就这么卡关了，似乎都不好拿啊！
然而还在林镜细细盘算之时，广成子已经眼神坚定的站了出来了！
现在双方斗宝已经到了最后一步，人员也不用纠结了！
阐教也只剩下这广成子还没有出战，而截教一方林镜是肯定要参加的！
毕竟此次斗宝虽然是阐教强词夺理，但是缘由还是和林镜脱不了干系的！
广成子看着对面的林镜嘲讽道：
“师弟，看你的样子应该修行的岁月不多吧！既然能够被圣人收为弟子应当好好珍惜，可不能一直凭借灵宝逞凶啊！”
林镜闻言还未说话，多宝道人直接怼道：
“灵宝也是自身实力的一部分好不好？有种你以后出门都别用灵宝！”
大殿之上，元始天尊饶有兴趣的看着林镜询问道：
“三弟，你这弟子什么来头，怎么连我也看不透啊！有趣！有趣！”
通天教主皱了皱眉，满不在乎的说道：
“机缘巧合之下随手收下的弟子而已，没什么能耐，等此间事了，定要让他好好修行了，这点实力传出去都丢人！”
元始天尊笑了笑没有说话，圣人收取弟子怎么可能会这么随便呢？
即使是截教如此多的生灵拜入，三弟不过也才收取了数十人为嫡传而已！
不过这个林镜竟然如此特殊，能够让通天教主出手为他遮掩天机？
而且之前的斗宝获胜的几位截教弟子，竟然都不约而同的将获胜的先天灵宝直接送给了他！

能够赐给座下弟子的灵宝，自然都是洪荒顶尖的法宝了！
先不说那清净琉璃瓶和七宝金莲已经是极品先天灵宝了，那戊己杏黄旗可是作为先天五方旗之一的至宝啊！
多宝道人就算在照顾师弟，也不可能随手就把这么一件至宝送出去了吧！
content_en:
Lin Jing looked at the shining apricot-yellow flag of Zhongwuji in his hand, and began to calculate the situation of the other treasures in his mind!
This innate five-directional flag has a lot of background, and the other flags are owned by several other great powers, so it is not easy to obtain them!
First of all, the flaming flag off the ground in the south is in the hands of Taiqing Saint of the Human Sect, and the purple-gold-red gourd among the innate gourds is also there!
Saint Taiqing values ​​purity and inaction, and his relationship with Jiejiao is quite harmonious. There should be hope that he can borrow these two spiritual treasures for use!
It seems that something has happened here, and he is going to find an opportunity to visit the Human Education!
The Oriental Green Lotus Flag should be in the hands of the Western Taoist Master Zhunti. This piece of Lin Jing must be the last one to consider!
These two saints of the Western Sect are not easy to mess with. If they discover the true form, it will be very disastrous to destroy the true spirit and refine it into a spiritual treasure again!
But there are so many good things in this Second Saint from the West, including the Seven Treasures Tree, the Six Pure Bamboo Roots, the Twelfth Grade Golden Lotus of Merits...
The plain flag of the Western Cloud Realm is said to have been passed down by Hongjun to his disciple Yaochi, who later became the Queen Mother of Heaven!
Lin Jing does not dare to go to Zixiao Palace now. It is still stressful to face Saint Hongjun in person!
But this purple-green gourd is also in the hands of Hongjun's disciple Haotian. Why do you feel that this mission is to let him die?
Apart from being a saint or a saint, there is only one goal left...
The controller of the Northern Xuanyuan Water Control Flag, Ancestor Styx!
This Patriarch of Minghe can be considered a miserable man. Although he has listened to Hongjun’s sermons, he is also one of the three thousand powerful men of Zixiao Palace!
It is a pity that it is stuck on the quasi-sage Dzogchen and has never been able to successfully achieve enlightenment and become a saint!
At that time, the saint Nuwa realized the way of creation and founded the human race to become a saint!
He also learned from it and created the Asura clan in the Netherworld Blood Sea, but unfortunately he failed to become a saint!
Later, Sanqing realized the way of enlightenment, established a separate religion, and achieved great merit and became a saint!
He also learned from it and established the Asura Sect in the Netherworld and Sea of ​​Blood, but unfortunately he still failed to become a saint!
Later, Zhunti took over and established the Western religion, and issued the Forty-Eight Great Visions to borrow a huge amount of merit and become a saint!
This time he didn't have anything to learn from, because Zhunti Jieyin had already wiped out the way of heaven, and he couldn't borrow anything from it...
However, this Ancestor of Styx is in the sea of blood, and his strength is only lower than that of the saint!
Finally found the only one who is not a saint, but Lin Jing cannot afford to offend...
This collection task seems to be so stuck, and it seems hard to get it!
However, while Lin Jing was still making careful calculations, Guang Chengzi had already stood up with firm eyes!
Now that the two sides have reached the final step in their treasure battle, the personnel no longer have to worry!
Guang Chengzi is the only one left in Chanjiao who has not yet participated in the battle, and Lin Jing, who is on the Jiejiao side, will definitely participate!
After all, although this treasure fight was an exaggeration, the reason was still inseparable from Lin Jing!
Guangchengzi looked at Lin Jing opposite and mocked:
"Junior brother, judging from your appearance, you probably haven't practiced for many years! Since you can be accepted as a disciple by a saint, you should cherish it, but you can't always rely on the spiritual treasure to do evil!"
Before Lin Jing could speak after hearing this, Taoist Duobao retorted directly:
"Ling Bao is also part of your own strength, okay? If you dare, don't use Ling Bao when you go out!"
Above the main hall, Yuanshi Tianzun looked at Lin Jing with interest and asked:
"Third brother, what is your disciple's background? Why can't even I see through it? Interesting! Interesting!"
Leader Tongtian frowned and said nonchalantly:
"He is just a disciple who was accepted casually by chance. He has no ability. When this happens, he must be allowed to practice hard. It would be a shame to spread this kind of strength!"
Yuanshi Tianzun smiled and said nothing. How could a saint accept disciples so casually?
Even though so many souls came to worship the Jie Cult, the third brother only accepted dozens of people as his direct successors!
But this Lin Jing is so special that he can let the leader of Tongtian cover the sky for him.machine?
Moreover, several Jiejiao disciples who had won previous treasure battles all unanimously gave the winning innate spiritual treasures directly to him!
The spiritual treasures that can be given to the disciples are naturally the top magic treasures in the world!
Not to mention that the pure glass bottle and the Seven Treasures Golden Lotus are already top-quality innate spiritual treasures. The Wuji Xinghuang Flag is a supreme treasure as one of the five innate flags!
Even if Taoist Duobao is taking care of his junior brother, he can't just give away such a treasure!
